name: Speko Router API
description: The Speko Router is streaming-first: live speech-to-text and text-to-speech sessions, and the three native speech-to-speech routes, all run over WebSocket and are specified in asyncapi.yaml, which this Router serves at /asyncapi.json. This document is the HTTP contract, the request/response surface beside those sockets: model discovery, batch speech transcription, one-shot speech synthesis, LLM responses over JSON or server-sent events, and Jev evaluations. The Go types in package relayapi are the source of truth for every shape in this document, and speccheck_test.go machine-checks the two against each other. The /v1 prefix is the stable major version: compatible fields and capabilities may be added, while breaking changes require a new major path. Before a v1 operation or field is retired, Speko documents a migration, sends the Deprecation header and a Link with rel="deprecation", and provides at least 90 days of notice before the Sunset date. See the public versioning policy for the complete compatibility contract.
